User: Welcome to Boardwalk Beer Garden. My name is Lana. Let me know if you need to speak to management and would like to be transferred. What's your name, and how can I help you? 
Agent: Yo, Lana, what’s up! Quick question for you — you guys showing the UFC fights? I’m talking Jones-Aspinall in 3 weeks, UFC 330. Like, is it a whole thing there or is it just on a TV in the corner while people eat salads? Me and my crew are looking for a real spot for fight night, not some place that puts the main card on mute. 

Do you guys do the full pay-per-view, prelims and all? How big are the screens — you got big ones, multiple TVs? And do you actually put the sound on, or is it silent with music over it?
Also, is there a cover charge for fight nights? Can we reserve a table close to the action? What’s the crowd like — is it rowdy, people into the fights, or more casual? Any fight night specials, like buckets or food deals? 

And how early do we gotta get there to lock down a good spot?We’re talking 5-6 guys, all big fight fans, so we wanna make sure it’s the right vibe. Oh, and do you show other sports too, like NFL or boxing? 

Let me know, Lana — we’re looking for a new home since our old bar shut down. If you guys do it right, we’ll be there every pay-per-view.
User: Love the energy. Here's the scoop. We play every major sporting event, including all the big UFC pay per views. Prelims and main card, full sound on, never muted. We've got fifteen large four k TVs and a massive one hundred fifty inch screen, so you'll have a killer view from anywhere, and the sound is always up for the fight. The crowd's a mix, Lots of real fans, definitely not just salad eaters. And the vibe is lively, but friendly, not out of control rowdy. No cover charge for fight nights, but we fill up fast. So I definitely recommend reserving a table close to the action for your crew. We do food and drink specials. Buckets, pitchers, and some great shareable plates. If you want the best spot, try to get here a little before the prelims start. And, yes, we show all the big sports. NFL, boxing, you name it. Want me to help you lock in a reservation for your group? 
Agent: Oh sick, you guys get it! That’s exactly what I wanted to hear. Fifteen big TVs and a 150-inch screen? That’s legit. And full sound, no mute — finally, someone who knows how to do fight night right. 

Yeah, if you can help me lock in a reservation for 6, that’d be perfect. We want to be right by that big screen if possible. Name’s Mike, by the way. 

Couple quick things — you said you do food and drink specials, what kinda stuff are we talking? Like, wings, sliders, buckets of beer? And just to double-check, it’s 21+ during the fights, or can younger fans come too? 

Also, what’s the biggest fight you guys have shown so far? Just curious, wanna know what kind of crowd you pull for the big ones. 

And yeah, let’s get that table locked in for UFC 330 — Jones vs Aspinall, October 19th. My number’s 347-555-0142 if you need it. Appreciate you, Lana!
User: Sure thing. I will send you our reservation link now. Please check your phone. Alright, Mike. You're all set. Check your phone for the reservation link so you can lock in that table for six right by the big screen for UFC three thirty. Jones versus Aspinall on October nineteenth. For food and drink specials, we've got all the fight night favorites. Wings, sliders, buckets of beer, pitchers, and plenty of shareable plates. The vibe is always electric for the big cards, and we've packed the house for some of the biggest US and boxing events. Think McGregor, Canelo, you name it. As for age, it's twenty one and up during fight nights. Thanks for choosing us, Mike. See you and your crew for the fights. 
Agent: Lana, you’re a legend. That’s exactly what I wanted to hear — wings, sliders, buckets, the whole deal, and you’ve packed it out for McGregor and Canelo fights? That’s how you know it’s a real fight crowd. Appreciate you getting me set up right by the big screen, too. 

Reservation link came through, I’ll lock it in for my guys. We’ll roll in before the prelims, get some food, settle in for the whole card. 

Seriously, thanks for making it easy. If you guys keep doing it like this, you just got yourself a new crew for every pay-per-view. See you on the 19th for Jones-Aspinall!
User: Thank you so much for all the info, Mike. Can't wait to see you and your crew on October nineteenth for the big fight. See you soon.
